prose: The Information reports, according to Techmeme, that interim Nvidia chief Colette Kress may take a more conservative approach and had challenged some riskier deals. The original article was unavailable. The feed supports an attributed account of management differences, not certainty about future capital-allocation decisions.
highlights: Feed describes possible change in risk appetite
Sources cite earlier objections to deals
basis: Techmeme headline and excerpt; source fetch failed.
